map.在 5×5（可调整）随机排列数字的方格中，按顺序尽快点击 1 到 25。完成时间: In a 5x5 (adjustable) grid of randomly arranged digits, click 1 through 25 in order as fast as you can. The shorter your time, the better your visual search and attention concentration. It is widely used for attention assessment and training, and also works well as a focus warm-up.
map.标准 5×5 方格，支持 4×4 / 6×6 等尺寸: Standard 5x5 grid, with 4x4 and 6x6 also supported
map.数字随机生成，每局不同: Numbers are generated randomly, so every round differs
map.可选倒序或字母模式: Descending order or letter mode available
map.纯前端运行: Runs entirely in the front end
map.注意力测评：用完成时间量化专注度: Attention assessment: quantify focus with the completion time
map.训练热身：学习或工作前激活专注: Training warm-up: activate your focus before studying or working
map.儿童专注力练习：有趣而不枯燥: Children's focus practice: engaging but not boring
map.选择方格尺寸（默认 5×5）点击开始: Choose the grid size (5x5 by default) and click start
map.按 1→2→3…顺序尽快点击数字: Click the digits in the order 1 → 2 → 3… as fast as you can
map.完成后查看用时与历史最佳: When you finish, see your time and your personal best
map.想更难就加大方格或切换倒序: For a harder challenge, enlarge the grid or switch to descending order
map.每天几局追踪进步: Play a few rounds a day to track progress
map.用余光扫全局比逐格找更快: Sweeping the whole board with peripheral vision is faster than searching cell by cell
map.视线跳动少、节奏稳成绩更好: Fewer eye movements and a steady rhythm give a better score
map.分心会显著拖慢，保持安静环境: Distraction slows you down a lot, so keep the environment quiet
map.完成时间受方格大小影响，同尺寸才可比: Completion time depends on the grid size, so only same-size runs are comparable
map.舒尔特方格注意力训练 - 在线工具: Schulte Grid Attention Training - Online Tool
map.完成时间多少算正常？: What completion time counts as normal?

map.为什么比朋友慢很多？: Why am I so much slower than my friends?
